artifacts.summary: Phased plan for abstracting shared MCS infrastructure into generic Foundations file and migrating Propositional, Modal, Temporal, and Bimodal logics

memory_candidates.content: CSLib's DerivationSystem + HasDeductionTheorem abstraction in Consistency.lean already provides the infrastructure for generic MCS properties. The deduction theorem itself cannot be genericized (requires concrete DerivationTree pattern matching due to Type-valued trees), but all MCS-derived properties (bot_not_mem, negation completeness, membership iff, mp_axiom) can be proved once generically and instantiated per-logic via the existing abstraction layer.
